h1.en: One upper pump mixing seal kit row, sequenced like Béton brut
h1.zh: 只有upper pump mixing seal kit这一行，次序仿《Béton brut》

directAnswer.en: Béton brut is an encyclopedia page. upper pump mixing seal kit remains a Xingtai catalogue line. The two meet only in the order of the sections. The upper-pump mixing seal kit is one row on the Xingtai mixing-seal page. The size cell for that row is blank. Service life is blank. No published pump is named as the upper pump.
directAnswer.zh: 《Béton brut》是百科页。upper pump mixing seal kit仍是邢台目录中的一行。两者只在章节次序上相遇。 上泵搅拌密封套件是邢台搅拌密封页上的一行。该行的尺寸格是空的。寿命是空的。没有已公布的泵被称作上泵。

body.en: “History” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. The row reads upper-pump mixing seal kit, unit set. It sits beside φ65, φ80 and the 1st to 4th generation kits. It does not inherit their sizes. Material is not printed. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. Integrated Mixer Pump and Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump do not use the words upper-pump seal. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write upper-pump mixing seal kit and the quantity. Leave OD blank unless you measured one on the machine, and label that measurement as measured rather than catalogue. The heading stops there.
body.zh: “历史”用来组织来源文章。组织在它下面的，是目录里的说法，数字保持原样。 这一行写的是上泵搅拌密封套件，单位套。它和 φ65、φ80 以及第一代至第四代并列。它不继承那些尺寸。材料没有印。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 搅拌泵一体机和柴油搅拌泵一体机都没有使用“上泵密封”这几个字。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明上泵搅拌密封套件和数量。除非在机器上量到外径，否则外径留空，并把量到的数字标明是实测而不是目录。 标题到此为止。

body.en: The contents list of the source page includes “Fabrication”. This section borrows that name and then repeats a printed fragment. The upper-pump mixing seal kit is one row on the Xingtai mixing-seal page. The size cell for that row is blank. Service life is blank. No published pump is named as the upper pump. No. Outer diameter is a missing field on the upper-pump row. No. φ80 is a different row. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 来源页目录里有“来源章节：Fabrication”。本节借用这个名字，然后复述已经印出的片段。 上泵搅拌密封套件是邢台搅拌密封页上的一行。该行的尺寸格是空的。寿命是空的。没有已公布的泵被称作上泵。 没有。上泵这一行的外径是缺字段。 不是。φ80 是另一行。 标题到此为止。

question.en: Why is Béton brut not a source of extra ratings for upper pump mixing seal kit?
question.zh: 为什么《Béton brut》不能给upper pump mixing seal kit增加额定值？

answer.en: No. Outer diameter is a missing field on the upper-pump row. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 没有。上泵这一行的外径是缺字段。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

question.en: Can the outline heading “Fabrication” rename upper pump mixing seal kit?
question.zh: 大纲标题“来源章节：Fabrication”可以改掉upper pump mixing seal kit的名称吗？

answer.en: No. φ80 is a different row. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 不是。φ80 是另一行。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
